free_tier_limits: No ongoing free tier. Custom API access requires the paid Core Pro plan. Personio offers a one-time 14-day software trial, not an ongoing API free tier.
rate_limits: v1 has a global limit of 2,000 requests/minute/IP. GET /v1/company/employees is limited to 300 requests/minute with a 15-requests/second burst. Other endpoint-specific limits may apply.
